# Naming Sub-Module

This sub-module generates default resource names using configurable templates and the `templatestring` function.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD033 -->
## Requirements

The following requirements are needed by this module:

- <a name="requirement_terraform"></a> [terraform](#requirement\_terraform) (>= 1.9, < 2.0)

- <a name="requirement_random"></a> [random](#requirement\_random) (~> 3.5)

## Resources

The following resources are used by this module:

- [random_string.unique_name](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/random/latest/docs/resources/string) (resource)

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Azure region for the resources.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: Controls whether telemetry is enabled for sub-modules.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_resource_name_defaults"></a> [resource\_name\_defaults](#input\_resource\_name\_defaults)

Description: A map of resource name templates keyed by resource type. Override individual templates to customize naming.  
Templates use the templatestring function with these available variables:
- resource\_name\_workload
- resource\_name\_environment
- location
- short\_location (abbreviated region name from the regions utility module)
- sequence (3-digit padded sequence number, e.g. 001)
- unique\_name (4-character random string for globally unique resources)

Type: `map(string)`

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_resource_name_environment"></a> [resource\_name\_environment](#input\_resource\_name\_environment)

Description: The environment name segment used in resource name templates.

Type: `string`

Default: `"dev"`

### <a name="input_resource_name_sequence_start_number"></a> [resource\_name\_sequence\_start\_number](#input\_resource\_name\_sequence\_start\_number)

Description: The starting sequence number used in resource name templates. Formatted as a 3-character string (e.g. 001).

Type: `number`

Default: `1`

### <a name="input_resource_name_workload"></a> [resource\_name\_workload](#input\_resource\_name\_workload)

Description: The workload name segment used in resource name templates.

Type: `string`

Default: `"demo"`

### <a name="input_web_app_keys"></a> [web\_app\_keys](#input\_web\_app\_keys)

Description: List of web app map keys, used to compute per-app sequence numbers.

Type: `list(string)`

Default: `[]`

### <a name="input_web_app_slot_keys"></a> [web\_app\_slot\_keys](#input\_web\_app\_slot\_keys)

Description: Map of web app key to list of deployment slot keys.

Type: `map(list(string))`

Default: `{}`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_resource_names"></a> [resource\_names](#output\_resource\_names)

Description: Computed resource names from templates.
